items.description: A goal's tags are shown once, on the goal. Its tiers used to repeat every inherited tag as a second, dimmer pill, so a branch of five tiers read as five copies of the same label down the column.
The tab bar sits against the header instead of floating below it, the filter bar hugs the list it filters, and the space between a goal's title and its progress and actions is tighter.
The gap between the page title and the timer is one step smaller, in line with the rest of the app.
